summary: Iteration 25 - RBAC (Admin/Technician), Users CRUD, Photos-status, Webhook outbound log, WhatsApp send-copy handshake. 25/25 backend tests passing (100%). All review request features verified end-to-end including webhook firing on status change to mastermaqassistencia.com.br endpoint and backward-compat for legacy tokens.
passed_tests: GET /api/auth/verify admin -> {valid, email, role=admin, user_id, name}
Backward-compat: legacy token (no role/name in payload) defaults role=admin and passes admin-only endpoints
GET /api/users (admin) returns list without password_hash/_id leak
POST /api/users (admin) creates technician with bcrypt password; duplicate email -> 400; invalid role -> 400
PUT /api/users/{id} updates name/active; cannot demote master admin (400); cannot deactivate master admin (400)
GET /api/users/technicians accessible by both technician and admin
GET /api/service-orders/{os}/photos-status returns {os_number, filled, count, all_done} with correct invariants

PUT /api/service-orders/{os} with status change fires webhook in background; new entry appears in outbound-log with payload {os_number, status, event_type=status_update} and url=.com.br; revert performed to avoid polluting data
POST /api/whatsapp/send-copy returns structured 4xx (not 500) with detail field when WA not configured / phone invalid
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2249 lines — recommend splitting into modules (auth, webhooks, whatsapp, photos, service-orders). Already partially done with users_module.py, manuais, whatsapp, inventory, routes, tracking — continue this pattern for /auth, /service-orders and webhook helpers.

send_webhook_status fires on every status change without retry/backoff or dedup. Since receiver currently returns 404, log will fill up — consider TTL index on webhook_outbound_log (sent_at) and a retry-with-backoff for transient 5xx (current implementation already logs but does not retry).

/api/whatsapp/send-copy raises HTTPException(detail={...}) with dict detail in upstream-error path — FastAPI does serialize dict detail correctly, but downstream clients should handle both str and dict detail shapes. Consider normalizing to a {step, message, raw} object for consistency.
Photos-status endpoint correctly limits projection (no _id leak). Good.

RBAC: /api/users/technicians is documented in test_credentials.md as 'admin-only' but the code allows any authenticated user (required by tech UI). Update doc string in users_module.py:194 — current comment is misleading.
/api/auth/verify and /auth/refresh re-fetch the user from DB on every call — for high-traffic scenarios, consider a 60s in-memory cache of {email -> user_record}.

Backward-compat default role='admin' in verify_token is correct for legacy admin tokens but is a latent security risk if any old technician tokens existed without role. Acceptable since pre-RBAC there was only one admin user.
